This information has been manually compiled. Some updates may not be included yet.
Lightning Ring and Thunderloop are now affected by Arcana II - Twilight Requiem
Bracelet is now affected by arcana XIV - Jail of Crystal. Bi-Bracelet is also affected by Arcana II - Twilight Requiem. Tri-Bracelet is also affected by Arcana XIX - Heart of Fire
Arcana II - Twilight Requiem's explosions damage is now affected by Curse.
The name of this Arcana is a reference to the song "
", the alternative name of An Empty Tome,
Twilight Requiem (II) can be unlocked in the
by casting the spell "lapapessa", which means "the high priestess" in Italian.
This makes Twilight Requiem (II) a representation of
Major Arcana card, symbolizing intuition, wisdom, enlightenment, divine knowledge, balance between masculinity and feminity, and the subconscious mind.
This is reflected in its ability to amplify the power of magic weapons while using Curse, which would normally be a disadvantageous stat.
This Arcana is one of the most prominent cases, alongside
, of an Arcana applying mostly to base weapons but not their evolutions, even when said weapons are not mechanically different.
